propositions: Generic property _assert_complete_or_loud passes shape-valid but content-hollow payloads (e.g., {} or record without ticket_id) on all four surfaces (show/list/search/ready) despite intent to certify complete-or-loud reads.

Seeded faults F3 (show emits {}, exit 0) and F6 (show emits record with ticket_id removed, exit 0) bypass generic tests but fail the original regression test_show_no_stall.py::test_cli_show_complete_or_erroring_under_write_burst.

Per-surface content-completeness predicates must be added to SURFACES table and enforced in _assert_complete_or_loud: show requires truthy ticket_id; list/search/ready require every element to carry truthy ticket_id (with valid-empty [] passing vacuously).
The strengthening is assertion-only with no new subprocess invocations, fixture rounds, or wall-clock runtime increase to the property.
